rationale: Power intent is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL21 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

low_power_modes_summary.run_mode_when_SPE_clear: Module clock to SPI core gated off; registers still accessible.
low_power_modes_summary.wait_mode_with_SPISWAI_1: SPI clock generation turned off; in-progress transmission stops/resumes per master/slave role.
low_power_modes_summary.stop_mode: SPI inactive (module clock disabled); independent of SPISWAI; in-progress transmission stops (master) or continues if SCK driven (slave).

fields.notes: Power management is the device's standby / deep-power-down modes and the tri-stating of the multi-IO lines between phases; the protocol itself is not a power-control protocol (unlike PMBus).

managed_power_states.description: CS# high, no command in progress; low quiescent current.
Entered via 0xB9 (Deep Power-Down); minimal current, released by 0xAB.

fields.output_enable_logic: The data lines IO0..IO7 are driven only during the appropriate phase (controller during instruction/address/write-data, device during read-data); otherwise tri-stated. DQS is driven by the device during octal-DDR reads.
fields.bus_power: Single-ended push-pull I/O; no bus pull-ups required (unlike open-drain I2C/SMBus). Program/erase draws the most current; standby and deep-power-down minimize it.
